method: Weighted Louvain, 30 seeds per weighting, consensus clustering at co-association >= 0.5. hubdamp: edge weight 1/sqrt(max(1,ka/10)*max(1,kb/10)); all: weight 1 per sourced edge. stability = mean share of member pairs co-clustered across the 30 raw runs.
